scope: Assembly schematic page and board assistant UX after user feedback

validation.nativeAutoOpen: I/O schematic_inspect then render_schematic_svg completed; actual drawing displayed; receipt matches saved sources
validation.missingSource: LCD missing schematic offers Find, Import, Generate; source details collapsed
validation.picker: KiCad-filtered picker opened; cancel returned without import
validation.generate: Prepared short LCD request with captured source context; not sent
validation.assistant: Prepared new board request is a compact corner dock; no root-netlist Finish it card

limits: Auto-open uses the existing declared source folder and canonical native schematic; arbitrary files elsewhere in a repository are not silently paired. Find with agent prepares a search request.
Import stages selected files with a scoped agent request; no direct native import completion claimed. Generation prepares a request; no circuit generation claimed.
Existing saved stale previews retain their warning and explicit Update action.
No remote publication; no provider/model configuration changes.
